_note: Proposed by BE-P for F01-T17c (D51, D81). The platform console is English only (X keys). Numbers to be assigned by Content; wording drafted, writers own it. Error keys match the codes the console routes answer with (no text comes from the server). Sample values are named variables.

en.X-new.enrol_greeting: Welcome, {name}. Set a password, then add an authenticator app.
en.X-new.enrol_done: Your sign-in is ready. You can sign in now.
en.X-new.enrol_invalid_link: This link is not valid any more. Ask a BOOQ admin for a new one.
en.X-new.enrol_weak_password: This password is not accepted. Choose a longer or less common one.
en.X-new.enrol_bad_code: That code is not right. Check the app and try again.
en.X-new.enrol_too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Enter your password again to start over.
en.X-new.enrol_invalid_enrolment: This step has expired. Open the link again and start over.
en.X-new.enrol_unavailable: Sign-in set-up is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
en.X-new.staff_link_once: Copy this link now and send it to {name}. It is shown only once and works only once.
en.X-new.staff_enrolment_not_configured: The life of enrolment links is not set. A BOOQ admin must set it in settings first.
en.X-new.staff_email_taken: A teammate with this email already exists.
en.X-new.staff_last_admin: You cannot deactivate the last active admin.
en.X-new.staff_same_person: You cannot do this to your own account. Ask another admin.
en.X-new.enrol_secret_hint: Add this setup key to an authenticator app on your phone, then enter the code the app shows.
en.X-new.staff_confirm_reset: Reset the second factor of {name}? Their open sessions end and they get a new enrolment link.
en.X-new.staff_confirm_deactivate: Deactivate {name}? They can no longer sign in.
en.X-new.staff_sign_in_required: Sign in to the console to manage the team.
en.X-new.staff_forbidden: Only a platform admin can manage the team.
en.X-new.staff_step_up_required: Confirm your second factor again before this action.
en.X-new.staff_unavailable: The team service is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
en.X-new.staff_bad_input: Check the name, email and role and try again.
en.X-new.signin_title: Sign in to the BOOQ console
en.X-new.signin_code_hint: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
en.X-new.signin_invalid_credentials: The email or password is not right.
en.X-new.signin_locked: Too many wrong attempts. This account is locked for a while. Try again later.
en.X-new.signin_challenge_invalid: This sign-in step has expired. Enter your email and password again.
en.X-new.signin_unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
en.X-new.signin_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
en.X-new.stepup_hint: This action needs a fresh check. Enter your password and the code from your authenticator app.
en.X-new.stepup_failed: The password or the code is not right.
en.X-new.stepup_session_ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
en.X-new.clubs_unavailable: The club list is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
